art_instructions: Draw a cozy woodland schoolroom with warm brown wooden walls, a bright yellow door, and soft green grass visible through wide windows. A semicircle of tiny desks with cushions is arranged on a small rug printed with alphabet letters. The owl, a small mottled brown-and-cream bird with round amber eyes, sits at one desk, looking attentively at a chart showing numbers 1-5 and the Greek letters α-ε on the wall. She holds a small wooden pointer in one talon and points to the chart. Her tiny green scarf is neatly tied, and a small satchel rests beside her on the desk. The koala is curled up asleep under the same desk, partially hidden but visible as a fluffy gray shape with his paws tucked under his chin. Sunlight streams softly into the room. Draw the scene in a Korean aegyo cute style with smooth lines and pastel colors.
